name: MMAU Music
description: A subset of the MMAU benchmark focused specifically on music understanding and reasoning tasks. Part of a comprehensive multimodal audio understanding benchmark that evaluates models on expert-level knowledge and complex reasoning across music audio clips.
reputation: Music-focused subset of MMAU; tests genre recognition, instrument identification, music theory, and cultural knowledge about music; challenging for frontier audio-language models
notes: Part of the full MMAU benchmark with 1,000 music-specific questions (out of 10,000 total in MMAU). Questions test genre classification, instrument recognition, pitch and rhythm understanding, music theory, and cultural knowledge. Human performance approximately 90%. Designed to probe expert-level music understanding.
